name: Da Lat strawberries
summary: Fresh strawberries from the Da Lat farms, the fruit on its own rather than the condensed-milk cup.
origin: Dâu tây Đà Lạt, named among the province’s OCOP strengths, and among the crops the farms are known for.
howToEat: Buy the fruit at the market in the daytime. The cup with condensed milk is dâu sữa, a different order. Wash the fruit if you are cautious.
where: Da Lat Market, on the slope above Xuan Huong Lake. Seasonal fairs, including one in Cam Ly, also sell strawberries.
